tests_command:
cd .claude/scripts
failed=0
for f in *.py; do
  [ "$f" = inbox_boundary.py ] && continue
  grep -q -- --selftest "$f" || continue
  python3 "$f" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "pass $f" || { echo "FAIL $f"; failed=1; }
done
for f in test_*.py; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  python3 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "pass $f" || { echo "FAIL $f"; failed=1; }
done
cd ../..
for f in .claude/skills/*/fixtures/test_*.py; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  python3 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "pass $f" || { echo "FAIL $f"; failed=1; }
done
exit $failed
